data.one_liner: Rich and fast PDF viewer and manipulation plugin built on PDFium.
data.what_it_does: pdfrx provides ready-to-use Flutter widgets for displaying and editing PDF documents. It supports page manipulation, document combining, and image importing across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
use_when: You need to display PDF files from assets, files, memory, or network URLs in your app.
You require cross-platform PDF viewing and text search capabilities.
You want a PDF solution built on top of PDFium for high performance.
avoid_when: You are unable to enable Developer Mode on Windows for building native assets.
You do not want to pull in the material_ui package dependency for UI localizations and theming.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web (WASM).
Provides ready-to-use widgets like PdfViewer, PdfPageView, and PdfDocumentViewBuilder.
Includes advanced features such as text search with pattern support and page manipulation.
weaknesses: Windows builds require Developer Mode to be enabled due to symbolic links.
Requires proper setup of material_ui localizations and theming for its Material widgets.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47 / Dart 3.13+, iOS 15+ / macOS 12+, and Windows Developer Mode enabled. Native builds require a C toolchain to compile a bundled library.
